review_unavailable: Evidence unavailable; approval will recheck it.
review_target_unavailable: Target content unavailable; a complete diff cannot be shown.
home_overview_empty: This scope has no saved sources or artifacts yet. Saved content will appear here.

note_source_reference_only: Only the reference is available for this source.
note_sources_empty: No source references were saved for this revision.
note_sources_scope: Sources belong to the revision you are reading.
processing_candidate_scope: This candidate reference was saved by the run. Open Review for its current status.

processing_inputs_incomplete: The saved input manifest is incomplete.
processing_inputs_unknown: No input manifest was saved for this execution.
processing_inputs_scope: These inputs belong to the execution as a whole. Check each result revision for its own direct sources.

review_raw_details: View complete proposal and raw diff

home_change_unreadable: This record could not be read; other content is unaffected.

prompt_explain_auto: Auto uses the defaults deployed with the current Server. A Server upgrade can change those defaults.
prompt_explain_no_effect: Viewing or saving a prompt does not call a model, turn generation on, or reprocess historical Sources.
prompt_explain_timing: Saved guidance applies to later scheduled and manual processing windows.
prompt_explain_constraints: Evidence, attribution, and output-format rules stay enforced whatever the instructions say.
prompt_custom_hint: Used only in Custom mode. Starting Custom from Auto begins with the built-in defaults shown above.
prompt_demonstrations_preserved: {count} existing demonstration(s) are kept when you save Custom instructions. Returning to Auto removes them from the active prompt; earlier revisions stay in history.
prompt_unsaved_changes: You have unsaved prompt changes. Leave this page and discard them?
prompt_saved_success: Prompt saved. The page below shows the stored revision.
prompt_conflict: Someone else saved this prompt while you were editing, so nothing was written. Your draft is kept below and now targets the latest revision. Review it, then save again.
prompt_write_error_blank_instructions: Custom instructions cannot be blank. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_invalid_mode: The selected mode is not valid. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_instructions_too_long: Custom instructions are too long. Shorten them to 32,768 characters or fewer. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_forbidden: Saving a prompt needs Scope administrator access. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_service_unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Nothing was saved; try again later.
prompt_write_error_capability_disabled: Custom instructions cannot be saved while this generation capability is disabled. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_prompt_customization_: Custom instructions cannot be saved while this generation capability is disabled. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_capability_unsupporte: This Prompt is managed outside the Dashboard, so Custom instructions cannot be saved. Nothing was saved.
prompt_write_error_invalid_request: The Server rejected this prompt. Check the instructions and try again. Nothing was saved.
work_followup_empty: No linked acknowledgement or outcome is recorded.
runtime_subtitle: Health checks for this service instance, independent of Scope and business counts.
runtime_checks_empty: The health check returned no dependency details.
runtime_boundary: Results cover only checks reported by this instance. They do not establish health for every worker, model call, metric, log, or trace path.
processing_topic_positions: Source cursor: {cursor}; source head: {head}. The difference is not a pending-source count.
processing_recent_sources_title: Recent sources and results · all dates
processing_attempt_more_inputs: This run has {count} additional sources not expanded here.
processing_runs_filtered_empty: No refinement or revision tasks match this status
method_generation_empty: No evidence is available. Choose another type or save a source first.
method_generation_no_op: No candidate was generated. You can select different evidence and try again.
method_generation_page_notice: Only selections on this page are submitted. Changing pages resets the selection.
method_generation_selection_required: Select at least one evidence item.
profile_generate_disabled: Profile generation is disabled. Enable it in the profile policy first.
profile_generate_conflict: The profile changed during generation. Please retry.
home_topic_attempt_reason: This window reached the automatic retry limit. This explains why retries stopped, not why the first attempt failed.
home_topic_budget_reason: This window reached its model request or token budget. Automatic processing is paused.
home_topic_recorded_reason: The recorded error below blocks this processing window.
home_issue_topic_budget_limit: Model request or token budget reached
home_issue_reason_unknown: The cause was not recorded. The blocked state alone cannot establish it.
home_issue_code_only: An error code was recorded, but no explanation is available.
home_topic_impact: Topic processing cannot continue for this window. Saved content remains readable.
home_topic_check: Check the latest error first. For a model timeout, check model connectivity and response time. Match service logs by blocked time, Scope and error code before restoring processing.
home_topic_model_timeout: The latest model call timed out.
processing_dream_help: Run created Dream tasks to organize content, such as refining experience, deriving skills or revising memories and profiles. Records show each task status and result.
processing_sources_subtitle: Review saved source text and its processing results.
processing_dream_subtitle: Review execution status and results for Dream tasks.
processing_retry_accepted: Retry accepted. Background processing has been requested; completion is not yet confirmed.
runtime_configuration_source: From this Server’s loaded startup configuration, shared by all Scopes. An enabled setting does not mean a task is running.
runtime_configuration_explicit: On demand through a button or API
runtime_configuration_unavailable: This service instance did not provide runtime configuration.
method_sync_notice: Synchronous generation waits for the model result, then opens review. It does not create a Dream task record.
method_dream_selection_notice: Select content, then start a background task. Track progress in Dream processing; results still require review.
processing_dream_no_output: This run recorded no new output.
processing_dream_more_inputs: {count} additional inputs are listed under references.
processing_dream_source_inputs: This run recorded {count} source references. Expand references to inspect them.
plugin_page_stopped: The plugin page navigated away from its start page, so requests are no longer forwarded for it. Reopen the page to continue.
prompt_topic_conditional: Stages run conditionally based on input size and processing results; not every request runs every stage.
prompt_reason_operation_disabled: This operation is disabled in the current runtime.
prompt_reason_provider_not_configured: The required model provider is not configured.
prompt_reason_injected_component: This operation is managed by an injected component.

topic_memory.global_purpose: Generate or update topics from sources
topic_memory.planner_purpose: Plan topic tasks for complex inputs

topic_memory.reduce_purpose: Reduce intermediate results while preserving evidence

prompt_opened_auto_summary: This revision uses Auto mode (built-in deployment defaults at runtime).
source_consumption_scope_notice: Current Scope; independent of the selected saved revision.
source_consumption_caught_up: Input consumption has caught up to the observed Source head.
source_consumption_unavailable: Processing observations are unavailable. Saved content remains independently readable.
source_consumption_unsupported: This deployment does not support reading Source-consumption status. Saved content remains independently readable.
source_consumption_unconfigured: Processing capability is not configured for this path.
source_consumption_profile_disabled: Profile Source-window generation is not enabled for this Scope.
source_consumption_review_pending: A Profile candidate awaits review; its Source window remains unconsumed until the review decision.
source_consumption_invocation_dirty: No invocation request is outstanding; domain work notifications remain.
source_consumption_invocation_acknowledg: Accepted invocation requests are acknowledged; this does not establish publication.
source_consumption_invocation_idle: The retained intent has no outstanding request or domain work notification.
source_consumption_invocation_unavailabl: No retained invocation observation is available.
source_consumption_executor_unavailable: Current execution is unavailable; external workers are not observed here.
source_consumption_executor_idle: The local scheduler observes no active execution for this Scope and binding.
source_consumption_executor_queued: The local scheduler observes queued work for this Scope and binding.
source_consumption_executor_running: The local scheduler observes execution for this Scope and binding.
source_consumption_executor_retry_wait: The local scheduler observes retry backoff for this Scope and binding.
source_consumption_executor_blocked: Local admission is blocked. This is a process-local observation, not a durable recovery record.
source_consumption_executor_pending: The local scheduler observes pending work for this Scope and binding.
source_consumption_executor_dirty: The local scheduler observes domain work notifications.
source_consumption_executor_acknowledged: The local scheduler observes an acknowledged invocation.
source_consumption_initial_position: An absent cursor or empty journal uses the processor's initial position 0.
source_consumption_policy_absent: No retained policy; generation is not enabled.
source_consumption_not_applicable: Not applicable to this Source-consumption path.
source_consumption_local: Local scheduler sample; not retained across restart
source_consumption_result_unavailable: Unavailable from these progress and intent records.
source_consumption_limits: Positions and generations are not artifact counts or completion percentages. Cursor movement and acknowledgement prove neither publication nor an explicit no-change result. Explicit generation and Dream outcomes are separate paths.
source_consumption_candidate_notice: Incubation can create review candidates; candidate creation does not establish Experience publication.
source_consumption_input_unavailable: Input progress is unavailable because the recorded cursor is ahead of the observed Source head.
auto_evidence_limit: Consumption and request acknowledgement do not prove publication. Missing execution observations do not prove the worker has stopped.
auto_block_window_attempt_limit: This window has used all its attempts
auto_block_window_provider_budget_exceed: This window has used its provider budget
auto_clue_block_limit: A processing limit was reached. No last-failure evidence is available for this window.
auto_clue_block_known: A block is recorded. Its saved evidence determines what can be explained.
auto_clue_execution_unknown: Execution, scheduling delay and worker availability cannot yet be distinguished.
auto_clue_read_error: Processing evidence for this type is currently unavailable.
auto_next_blocked: Inspect the most recent failure before deciding whether to resume processing.
auto_next_retry: Wait for the next scheduling check. Use the diagnostic guide if failures repeat.
auto_next_running: Refresh later to check whether consumption advances.
auto_next_pending: Check runtime configuration and the background service, then inspect recent errors.
auto_next_outputs: Use the input list below to inspect saved artifacts.
auto_next_read_error: Check runtime state. Saved inputs remain readable.
auto_cause_inference_timeout: The last model request timed out
auto_cause_model_timeout: The last model request timed out
auto_cause_generation_unavailable: Generation was not configured or was unavailable
auto_clue_local: Only this process scheduling state is confirmed. Other worker processes are not visible.
auto_clue_waiting_capacity: This process is using its worker capacity. The task is waiting for a free slot.
auto_clue_waiting_dispatch: The scheduler has observed the task but execution has not started.
auto_next_timeout: Check model service response times and timeout settings before deciding whether to resume processing.
context_invalid: The receipt is invalid or does not match this context.
context_budget_bytes_hint: Counted in UTF-8 bytes, not characters. One CJK character usually takes 3 bytes: "context" is 7 characters and 7 bytes, but "上下文" is 3 characters and 9 bytes.
context_no_selected: No references were selected in this response.
context_omitted_hint: These are grouped counts. They cannot explain why one specific memory was not selected.
context_boundary: This response does not prove host injection or model adoption.
context_history_empty: No matching records. Only actual calls made with capture enabled are retained.
context_partial: Receipt unavailable; recorded counts remain readable
context_error_inference_privacy: Model privacy policy rejected the operation
context_text_not_recorded: No text recorded for this stage.
context_text_incomplete: Some stage text could not be recorded.
topic_processing_execution_unknown: Current execution state is unknown, including work in external processes.
topic_processing_publication_notice: Input progress does not prove publication or a recorded no-change outcome.
topic_processing_unavailable: Processing observations are unavailable. Saved topics remain independently readable.
topic_processing_error: Processing status could not be loaded
topic_processing_origin: Evidence: durable records for this Scope and the Topic Memory Source-window binding. Positions describe input consumption, not artifact counts or completion percentages.
topic_processing_no_budget: No allowance record is available for the current frontier.
topic_processing_budget_notice: Reservations are conservative and are not exact calls, token usage or billing. A spent allowance alone does not prove that its final attempt has stopped.
topic_processing_last_error: Last error code retained with this block
topic_processing_observed_at: Block first observed at (not failure time)
topic_processing_block_target: Target when the block was observed
topic_processing_no_block: No applicable retained block diagnostic is available. This does not establish healthy execution; this page does not create missing legacy diagnostics.
